name: service-lead-api

references.role: our approved icon from the same family (the turbocharger fitting, picked 11 Nov 2026): match its outline weight, shading, palette and finish only; do not copy its shape

art_plan.icon: button: run a service lead (a power and air line) from a station to a parked vehicle
art_plan.size: drawn by the game at about 64 to 80 px as a command button; requested at 1024
art_plan.this_request: night 6 follow-up, the owner's pick of 18 Nov 2026: the local candidates were turned down and the owner asked for the paid API; two attempts

prompt:
SMALL GAME ICON. One single object seen from the front, centred, flat on the canvas, like a command button in a strategy game.

Create an ORIGINAL small game icon for a vehicle service lead. Image 1 is our approved icon from the same family: match its outline weight, shading, palette and finish only. Do NOT copy its shape.

Draw ONLY the object, alone on a plain pure white background, filling about 80 percent of the canvas. Square canvas.

A bright orange cable reel on a small dark steel stand, with a thick black heavy-duty lead unwound from it in one smooth curve, ending in a chunky industrial plug with a yellow collar.

Style: a sprite for the game RimWorld: a thick near-black outline around every shape, soft flat cel shading with two or three tones per material, rounded corners, a few small clean details, no texture noise. Not a photograph, not a 3D render, not pixel art. It must read clearly when shrunk to 64 pixels: one big shape, very few small ones.

No people, hands, animals, vehicles, text, letters, numbers, logos, screens, dust, floor, ground or cast shadow.
